[EN] The House that Mansur Built
[ES] La casa que construyó Mansur
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We've got to make every bit count.
[ES] Tenemos que aprovechar hasta el último pedazo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] This frozen wood is stronger than I thought. Great!
[ES] Esta madera congelada es más fuerte de lo que pensaba. ¡Genial!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I hear that."
[ES] "Eso lo he oído."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Gather timber from the deserted house near the Frost Wastes.
[ES] Reúne madera de la casa abandonada cerca de Frost Wastes.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the timber to Mansur in the ruined village in the northeast Frost Wastes.
[ES] Entrega la madera a Mansur en el pueblo en ruinas al noreste de Frost Wastes.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
